title: ltestats v1

access_Technology.$comment: NOTE THE CAPITAL T. Production sends access_Technology. Every document in this repository said access_technology before 29 Aug 2026; that spelling came from the SRS and has never appeared on the wire. Under ADR-007 production is the authoritative wire format, so the capital is correct and the lowercase spelling is the bug.

imsi.$comment: Sensitive identifier. Charset is constrained but length is deliberately not: rejecting a valid IMSI on a guessed length would dead-letter real traffic. Masking policy is still pending approval.

signedNumericString.$comment: Signal values are STRINGS on the wire - production sends "rssi": "-67", not -67. Constrained to an optionally-signed integer so a non-numeric value dead-letters at the Writer rather than failing a cast at query time. The Writer parses to INTEGER and MUST range-check before conversion.

hexString.$comment: lac and cid are hexadecimal strings (55F3, 61D93D, 28DC413). Width is left generous on purpose; only the charset is asserted.

$comment: Re-derived from the 29 Aug 2026 production sample (ADR-007). TWO corrections against the previous SRS-derived draft, each of which alone dead-lettered 100% of ltestats traffic: every numeric is a STRING on the wire, not an integer; and the field is access_Technology with a capital T. timespan is optional - one of the three production records omits it.
